title: Hai-Kau River
excerpt: Hai-Kau River is a natural river in Deepond Island . Desscription [ ] Hai-Kau River flows from Deepond to the sea of West Metropolis Archipelago . This river has two estuaries, one in the east and one in the north. The east estuary flows from the north of Deepond to Hai Kau, East Pond and East Coast. After merging with Lighthouse River it reaches East Pond Bay. The north estuary flows into North Sand Bay.
